All five lead records are correctly classified. Every field is 'none found' with no sources and no value, and no URL, fee, deadline, identifier, phone number or e-mail address is given. 1.verdict:
I checked all 5 institutions with 6 WebSearch calls (limit 15, never refused). All searches used allowed_domains registry.edbo.gov.ua; every result is a search-summary lead, not evidence. I modified no repository files. Overall the batch is mostly faithful to its extracts. The repeated weaknesses: fields marked 'conflicts with record' but not classified as conflicting; a few claims with no cited source; 4 capture URLs that no field cites; and two EDEBO e-mail leads that were missed.

KhPI (kharkiv-polytechnic-institute): search 1 found the EDEBO card 104 as recorded: Ukrainian name, short name НТУ "ХПІ", website www.kpi.kharkov.ua, acting rector Тимченко Галина Миколаївна, founded 01.01.1885, related units 2926 and 989. It also surfaced a related unit not in the batch, Міжгалузевий інститут післядипломної освіти (code 2829); that is incomplete, not wrong. Corrected: medicalProgrammes should be conflicting (the record's own 226 level is 'master' while its skeptic note says bachelor), and requiredDocuments is tied to a URL the summary never named.

Corrected: the 'rector's report for 2025' has no source; the 5187 college has no cited source (my search found it at /university/5187/specialities); medicalProgrammes is a missed conflict and its 'Industrial Pharmacy' naming is unsupported; the NAQA 'employer only' claim has no source; and the urlsToCapture entry /SelectionCommittee/Masters is cited nowhere. New finding: the same EDEBO card gives the e-mail [e-mail on ksu.ks.ua]. That means officialContacts is not 'none found', and the domain is now conflicting (kspu.edu site, ksu.ks.ua e-mail).

5.verdict:
10 WebSearch calls in all (2 per institution, under the 3-per-institution limit; none refused). Everything I saw is a search summary, so it is a lead, not evidence. Nothing here is verified.

KNU (2 searches): Confirmed EDEBO code 41, the Ukrainian name and short name КНУТШ, the legal address at Volodymyrska 60, and the registerListing items: units 545 and 548 blocked with 41 as successor, 3728, the 5761 unit title. The 545/548/5761 details were missing from the cited extracts but my re-search showed them. The re-search also showed 1476 (National Academy of Public Administration) naming 41 as successor. Corrected 9 items. Most important: domainOwnership and officialContacts. The EDEBO summary does list knu.ua plus [e-mail on knu.ua] and [e-mail on knu.ua]. Also unsupported claims in internationalAdmission, requiredDocuments, entryRequirements (B2, rector's order, contract) and currentStatus (2026-06-26); a missed record conflict in entryRequirements; 'names no programme' overstated in accreditationLicensing; one capture URL with no source. The Ministry portal again returned no KNU entry. Name-confusion risk: Kryvyi Rih National University uses knu.edu.ua. Minor: the officialWebsite subdomains mobility.knu.ua and fit.knu.ua appear in no source.

TNMU (2 searches): Confirmed EDEBO 102, the Ukrainian and English names, maidan Voli 1, tdmu.edu.ua, [e-mail on tdmu.edu.ua] and 12.04.1957. The Ministry portal entry university/68 lists https://www.tdmu.edu.ua/en/ and is titled 'I. Horbachevsky ...', which matches the record's form. Corrected 6 items. Most important: tuitionFees. Ukrainian-track 3,300 and 2,500 are unsupported, 3,000 is misattributed to the 2024/2025 page, and the year conflict was missed. Also: a currentStatus conflict missed against the record's 2024–25 classroom statement, with the 2026 OSCE remote line left out; '926 applicants' is unsupported; '1 September internship' is unsupported; two capture URLs have no source.

USTU (2 searches): Confirmed EDEBO 6507, УДУНТ and the English name, Lazaryana 2, ust.edu.ua and 26.04.2021. The Ministry portal entry 114/contacts confirms ust.edu.ua and adds postcode 49010 plus [e-mail on ust.edu.ua]. Corrected 6 items. Most important: registerListing. The college unit seen in the register is 6546 (Kryvyi Rih), not 6514, and 6541 was not shown as blocked. Also: unsupported predecessor details and 'merged into Lviv Polytechnic' in currentStatus; the 'College ... grade 9' pharmacy claim; the '22 November 2024' deadline; officialContacts 'none found' (a government-portal lead exists); one capture URL with no source. Minor: 'two-stage competitive selection' in entryRequirements is not in its extract.

UzhNU (2 searches): Confirmed EDEBO 207, the Ukrainian name ДВНЗ 'УжНУ', 18.10.1945, uzhnu.edu.ua, units 1153 and 4133, and 100 blocked with 207 as successor. Portal entry 158/contacts confirms uzhnu.edu.ua and [e-mail on uzhnu.edu.ua]. Corrected 5 items. Most important: the reorganisation conflict in currentStatus was not classified as conflicting leads. Also: 'same head for 207 and 103' is unsupported; '4133 blocked in 2022' is unsupported; a new location conflict, since the Ministry portal gives Narodna Square 3, 88000 against the EDEBO legal address at Pidhirna 46; one capture URL with no source. Minor: dspace.uzhnu.edu.ua is in no source.

The 2020–21 table, the 1,700 preparatory fee and the 300 USD insurance figure appear in no extract.
